name: Gijón (Spain)
description: White field with a broad red border, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Gijón (King Pelayo with the Victory Cross on white).
history: The flag of Gijón is rectangular, its length three halves of its width, white with a red border on its four sides one sixth of the length wide and the municipal arms in polychrome at the centre; it originates in the registration ensign assigned to the maritime province of Gijón by royal decree of 30 July 1845.
